items.text: Just waiting for the drama to start up again lol I don’t care! Land of the free 4ever. So proud of them, especially for going on TV and getting the message out there! Love them so much

Haha gotta say this might be the first time a comment of his from an interview rubbed me the wrong way. I don’t know, kind of seemed like the interviewer was trying to get something provocative out of him, maybe that’s why he seems a little direct?

Almost like he wishes he could forget it lol I don’t know why! I get that they were given a hard time because the sound wasn’t working properly or whatever, but watching the set on YouTube, it seemed like such a good show! Just think he’s sensitive about the criticism at the time.

That’s such a shame since it’s hardly their fault. I hope everything runs smoothly this time and we won’t have to see any keyboards thrown, although that is a little bit fun if I’m telling the truth lol
Does anyone know why Mark didn’t play on this one? I know all songs were recorded the other day for night one there. Maybe he didn’t have enough time to learn the song or Jake felt more comfortable?
They *were* more focused on putting a message out than producing a “good song”... that’s literally the entire point.
Cringey definitely describes American politics at the moment. Good on Brandon for being fearless with this song.
Musicians who are allowed to have and express views and opinions, just like you.
Watched this at home but first show of theirs I’d ever seen. Let’s just say it started everything for me!

Both Borgata shows I went to were amazing, but I think the 2017 one is closer to my heart because Dave was MUCH more into it. I think he was pretty unhappy in 2016 with whatever was going on in the band and it showed. He pretty much stood still the whole time and ignored the audience. In 2017, he was walking around the stage, doing tricks with his guitar, coming to the front of the stage for solos, much more of the Dave I’m used to seeing in old footage. Maybe it’s because it was right before he stopped playing with them. He probably knew those were his last few shows so he gave it his all and was really present. Besides Dave, it was really cool to see the premiere of Run for Cover and I feel like the banter Brandon makes with the Borgata crowd is especially sincere and cute. He said how much he missed us and felt like it’s been way too long. He also acknowledged how much they play there and how it feels like home to them. For those who don’t live in the US or know much about the location, the Borgata is a casino in Atlantic City, NJ— another town with lots of casinos. I know people are pretty puzzled around here why were all so Borgata obsessed but I blame Brandon for making us feel this way lol
Am I allowed to say Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas? Damn I love that solo!!

The Man is my favorite from Wonderful Wonderful and with their other albums my fave is never a lead single so take from that what you will haha! I don’t hate Wonderful Wonderful but it just really doesn’t resonate with me at all. I appreciate the sentiment of it though. The Man has to be one of my most played songs and music videos of all time!

You’ve got a whole lot of Sams Town diehards around these parts. Critics just didn’t like that it wasn’t anything like Hot Fuss. I wasn’t really following them closely back then, but I’m pretty sure I wouldn’t want every single one of their albums to sound the same. Sams Town just hits that sweet spot personally for a lot of fans, maybe not necessarily critics. I like to think of that album as sort of an early adult right of passage, kind of like the book Catcher in the Rye is for a lot of people. All of the feelings of restlessness, confusion, passion, defiance are laid out so clearly for you to relate to. Even though it was panned back then, I think it’s generally regarded as their most fluent and cohesive album to date.

It’s low on the list for me too. I appreciate how many ridiculously great songs are on there, but I never really find myself itching to listen to it. It could be because all of the successful singles on there that I’ve heard a million times.
My husband hates it so much that he skips it every time we listen to Day and Age together so I rarely listen to it 😂

I love staying here. Will be there next Friday night! Can’t wait! Besides being iconic for us Killers fans, it’s also a really great deal for a hotel. Reasonably priced, clean, beautiful lobby. I love you Sams Town! You really do feel like you’re home when you see the sign.
Doesn’t mean I don’t like it!

It’s funny... they’re so equal in my mind! Sometimes I’m more in a Flamingo mood, other days I’m in a TDE mood. That’s why I love his solo work! Those two albums are so special to me. I can maybe see why people would like TDE more as an album because it’s really sharp and interesting but Flamingo is such an emotional journey! They’re like my two children, couldn’t possibly love one more than the other.
Ugh, I’d give anything to listen to Sam’s Town for the first time again. There’s nothing like it! So glad there are still people out there experiencing it in 2019.
Yeah, I’m sure I’d maybe have felt differently if I listened to it for the first time back in 2006. Was much later for me, and I sort of viewed Hot fuss as a greatest hits, which I still sort of do.

I agree. I don’t have anything against WW but just knowing jackknife did WW and Ariel did TDE, I was just wayyyy more excited when I saw the FaceTime tease about Ariel. Doesn’t look like much has been going on with TK and Ariel though which is disappointing. Maybe they are still writing and experimenting with Jackknife and will record with Ariel, that’d be great.
“Faith” “My God” “Amen” 😂 oh Brandon... praise Jesus this is amazing news
That’s our boy!
Exactly my first thought!

It’s one of my favorites of theirs too. It definitely “conjures up” as Brandon loves to say, a certain mood and certain feelings. The lyrics are actually really beautiful if you pay attention! I love Brandon’s voice on this one too, sort of Sams Town raspy but at certain points it’s really smooth! Then the synth from My List at the end, ugh! I love when instruments give a physical voice to emotions and to me it really sounds like weeping!—which is what I do a whole lot when listening to this song 😂
I wonder the same thing. If they do another Q and A (god help us) 😂 I will try to ask this!
